Odoo ERP Consulting & Development

Odoo 18, configured and extended around how your business works

Services

Odoo services

Odoo Configuration & Business Analysis

We start with how your teams actually work, then configure Odoo to fit.

  • Business process analysis
  • Sales and purchasing workflows
  • Inventory configuration
  • Multi-company environments
  • Business process optimization
  • CRM pipelines and approval flows

Odoo Custom Development

Custom modules when standard Odoo is not enough — built upgrade-aware and kept in version control.

  • Python development
  • XML views and interface customization
  • Custom module development
  • Business logic customization
  • Access rights and record rules
  • Automated activities and approval rules

Odoo Testing & Troubleshooting

Structured testing before go-live, and focused investigation when something goes wrong.

  • Functional testing
  • Regression testing
  • Error investigation
  • Inventory and stock discrepancy analysis
  • Sales order workflow validation
  • Technical troubleshooting

Odoo.sh & On-Premise

Safe development and release workflows across development, staging and production.

  • Development, staging and production environments
  • Git-based development workflows
  • Branch management
  • Deployment reviews
  • Technical environment troubleshooting

Approach

How an Odoo engagement runs

No surprises in production: every change is understood, tested and explained before it goes live.

  1. 01

    Understand

    Sessions with your team to map processes, roles and pain points — before touching any configuration.

  2. 02

    Design & configure

    Standard Odoo features first; a clear list of what needs a custom module, and why.

  3. 03

    Develop

    Custom modules kept in Git and deployed through Odoo.sh branches or your own release process.

  4. 04

    Test on staging

    Every change tried on a copy of your data, with a step-by-step test guide for your managers.

  5. 05

    Train

    Key users and teams trained on their own daily flows, in their own language.

  6. 06

    Go live & support

    Backup and rollback plan before release, then follow-up while the team settles in.
